description: This file defines the LuceneQueryDisplayDriver class, which manages display, editing, and updating of Lucene search queries within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles rendering query summaries, editing query parameters, and validating user input.

classes.name: LuceneQueryDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for Lucene queries, providing display, edit, and update functionalities within OrchardCore.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Renders a summary view of the Lucene query if the source matches.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Provides an editor interface for modifying Lucene query parameters.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes the submitted form data to update the Lucene query, including validation.
